exact_translations.source: The Energy Sciences Network (ESnet) is the US Dept of Energy (DOE) Office of Science’s high-performance network user facil- ity, delivering highly-reliable data transport capabilities optimized for the requirements of large-scale science. ESnet is stewarded by the Advanced Scientific Computing Research Program (ASCR) and managed and operated by the Scientific Networking Division at Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory (LBNL). ESnet acts as the primary data circulatory system for science by interconnecting the DOE’s national laboratory system, dozens of other DOE sites, and 150 research and commercial networks around the world. It allows tens of thousands of scientists at DOE laboratories and academic institutions across the country to transfer vast data streams and ac- cess remote research resources in real-time. ESnet exists to provide the specialized networking infrastructure and services required by the national laboratories, large science collaborations, DOE user facilities, and the DOE research community. All together, ESnet provides a foundation for the nation’s scientists to collaborate on some of the world’s most important scientific challenges,including energy, biosciences, materials, and the origins of the universe. Sci- ence data traffic across its network has grown at around 60% each year, and traffic has exceeded an exabyte per year since 2019.

exact_translations.source: Table 1 shows the basic statistics on the data access activities for all caching nodes during the study period (from July to Dec. 2021). The "data transfer size" column in Table 1 indicates the data volume resulting from the "cache misses", when a data file was transferred from the remote data source. For cache misses, any caching nodes in the SoCal Repo did not have the data, resulting in a data transfer from the remote site to one of the caching nodes. The "shareddataaccesssize" columnrefersto the data volume from the "cache hits", when the data file was shared from the cache. The shared data accesses correspond to the network traffic savings. As the new cache nodes were added every month since Sep 2021, the percentage of shared data size decreases with time because the requests would fill the new cache nodes first by the policy. The percentage of the share size would be maintained at a certain level after the cache nodes are full.
exact_translations.target: 表 1 给出了研究期间（2021 年七月至十二月）所有缓存节点数据访问活动的基本统计信息。表 1 中的“数据传输大小”列表示“缓存未命中”产生的数据量，即数据文件从远程数据源传输时的传输量。发生缓存未命中时，南加州仓库中的缓存节点均未持有该数据，因而需要将数据从远程站点传输至某个缓存节点。“共享数据访问大小”列表示“缓存命中”产生的数据量，即数据文件由缓存共享时的数据量。共享数据访问量对应于节省的网络流量。由于自 2021 年九月起每月都会新增缓存节点，而请求会按照策略优先填充新节点，因此共享数据量所占比例随时间下降。缓存节点填满后，共享数据量比例将维持在一定水平。

exact_translations.source: Two additional caching nodes have been deployed within ESnet to supplement the existing Sunnyvale node within the broader SoCal Repo (Fig. 9). These nodes were installedasphysical servers at ESnet points of presence (PoP) in Boston and Chicago. The specifications of each node is as follows: dual-socket Intel Xeon Gold 5220S CPUs, 384GB RAM, 12x Micron 9300 PRO 15.36TB NVMe SSDs, and Mel- lanox ConnectX-5 100G network interface cards (NICs). The node storage was configured to provide an effective 165TB of available capacity each while providing suitable performance to match the expected XCache usage given 100G network connectivity. Figure 10 shows the results of using the elbencho{v1}storage benchmarking tool on the caching filesystem exposed to a container.
exact_translations.target: ESnet 内部又部署了两个缓存节点，以补充更大范围南加州仓库中现有的 Sunnyvale 节点（图 9）。这些节点以物理服务器形式安装在 ESnet 位于波士顿和芝加哥的接入点（PoP）。每个节点的规格如下：双路 Intel Xeon Gold 5220S CPU、384GB 内存、12x Micron 9300 PRO 15.36TB NVMe 固态硬盘，以及 Mellanox ConnectX-5 100G 网络接口卡（NIC）。每个节点的存储均配置为提供 165TB 的有效可用容量，同时在 100G 网络连接条件下提供与预期 XCache 用途相匹配的性能。图 10 展示了使用 elbencho{v1}存储基准测试工具对暴露给容器的缓存文件系统进行测试所得的结果。

exact_translations.source: Generally, the Linux macvlan sub-interface type provides iso- lation from the host networking namespace at layer 2. From an external ESnet switch or router perspective, a container with a macvlan interface will appear as another unique host on the net- work with a unique MAC and/or IP address. For the baremetal host to communicate with the running container, another macvlan sub- interface must be created on the host and local routing adjusted for any configured layer 3 subnet(s). In a similar fashion, another con- tainermay also communicate withinthe macvlan subnetif attached to the same brdiged container network. In this manner DTNaaS service containers provide separation between networks allocated for each service container and reduce the complexity of a single filtering rule set maintained alongside the host network namespace.
exact_translations.target: 通常，Linux macvlan 子接口可在第 2 层实现与主机网络命名空间的隔离。从外部 ESnet 交换机或路由器的角度看，带有 macvlan 接口的容器会表现为网络上的另一台独立主机，并具有唯一的 MAC 地址和/或 IP 地址。为使裸机主机与运行中的容器通信，必须在主机上创建另一个 macvlan 子接口，并针对所有已配置的第 3 层子网调整本地路由。类似地，连接到同一桥接容器网络的另一个容器也可以在 macvlan 子网内通信。通过这种方式，DTNaaS 服务容器可隔离分配给各服务容器的网络，并降低在主机网络命名空间中维护单一过滤规则集的复杂度。
exact_translations.reason: Manual review removes the extraction-derived plural suffix while preserving layer 2 and layer 3 roles.

exact_translations.source: In this paper, we described our design, deployment and experience on DTN-as-a-Service (DTNasS) as our approach for supporting in- network caching and storage services for scientific datasets within ESnet. We also described observations on the data access trends in the existing SoCal Repo for HEP analysis jobs at Caltech and UCSD. In-network data cache enables reduction of the redundant data transfers and consequently network traffic savings. During the study period, 1.4PB of the network traffic volume savings was observed in the SoCal Repo, and the study opens other leads to the network engineering and caching policies. Data access trends such as Figures 8 and 7 would be able to predict the trend of the network traffic demand in the regional cache. Also, cache hits analysis such as Figure 3 would enable different types of the caching policy based on the dataset popularity. We plan to extend this analysis to observe caching trendswith the inclusion of the two newnodes as described, and we plan to study data-driven network traffic engineering and traffic volume forecasting as well as locally customized caching policy in the future.
exact_translations.target: 本文介绍了 DTN 即服务（DTN-as-a-Service，DTNasS）的设计、部署与实践经验；这是我们在 ESnet 内为科学数据集提供网内缓存和存储服务的方案。我们还介绍了 Caltech 和 UCSD 高能物理分析作业访问现有南加州仓库数据的趋势。网内数据缓存能够减少冗余数据传输，从而节省网络流量。研究期间，南加州仓库节省了 1.4PB 的网络流量；这项研究也为网络工程和缓存策略提出了其他研究方向。图 8 和图 7 所示的数据访问趋势可用于预测区域缓存的网络流量需求趋势；图 3 所示的缓存命中分析则可支持根据数据集流行度采用不同类型的缓存策略。我们计划将上述两个新节点纳入分析，以进一步观察缓存趋势；未来还将研究数据驱动的网络流量工程、流量预测以及本地定制的缓存策略。
exact_translations.reason: Manual review binds 1.4PB to network-traffic savings and preserves all figure references.
